baseline: actual frozen R23 source; R22 accepted commit afec5354d1e0eca09f10ccabd73a01be2f14092c
only_source_arm_difference: VERIFY_BUFFER_BYTES constant; original PinnedFile/helpers, fixed-shell resolver and public load block copied verbatim
guard: actual OwnerTicket::check_current method body with real CancellationToken and tokio::time::Instant in a thin field shape; no worker/admission/permit/lifecycle implementation
primary_metric: thread CPU per complete public triplet; one verify of each file, fixed-shell resolution and outer current checks retained
secondary: equal-frequency sum of per-file CPU ratios
compile: one rustc +1.95.0 invocation reusing qualified opt-level=1 rlibs; LTO off, no Cargo invocation or dependency builds
execution_not_before: R23 qualification and formal campaign have finished; root separately authorizes and schedules the component with no overlapping owned workload
early_stop: Missing/ambiguous/changed rlibs, compile/link failure, incomplete records, failed preflight, or failed component gate stops this direction without Cargo fallback or parameter sweep.
private_input_access: No private profile/config/known-hosts read or retained. Setup fingerprints only fixed SSH, false and resolved fixed system shell, then both arms perform original SHA-pinned load against those public fingerprints.
limits: Component CPU is not release RPC or cluster throughput.
This is dev opt-level=1 plus no-LTO component code, not the production release binary optimizer context.
No worker/owner lifecycle, SSH/agent lookup, private input or whole-profile qualification.
64 KiB reduces checkpoints per byte; cancellation observation time and race-dependent error ordering can change. No hard cancellation-time bound is claimed.
Each active verification stack buffer grows 48 KiB. Both arms/references coexist; RSS is not comparable.
The global production constant also affects three private SHA inputs and SHA fallback; this public-only screen cannot establish their non-regression or authorize a global constant change.
